subject: Re: Packaging and pricing for advanced dashboards + trace retention
messages:
From: Samir Gupta <samir@harborai.com>
To: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.ai>
Cc: Alicia Park <procurement@harborai.com>
Date: Thu, 02 May 2028 09:14:00 -0700
Subject: Packaging for dashboards + trace retention (Harbor AI)

Mina — thanks again for the demo yesterday. Harbor AI loved the advanced dashboard visuals but we need clarity on how observability add-ons are packaged and priced before we take this to procurement. Primary questions: 

- For customers at our scale (~1B tokens/month), what is the recommended trace retention tier versus per-GB archival? Any hard thresholds where the unit economics change?
- Do advanced dashboards (heatmaps, session replay, anomaly-triggered views) come as a separate SKU or bundled with tracing retention?
- We also need a discount framework for a 12-month committed path and the pilot period — specifically how many pilot credits versus committed discounts.

Can you send a simple example cost profile (pilot -> commit -> steady state) and any contract-level concessions you typically offer (SOW credits, onboarding waivers, trial extensions)? We want to present a clear option to procurement next week.

Attachment: usage_snapshot_may.xlsx (internal)

—Samir
Samir Gupta
Head of Platform, Harbor AI

From: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.ai>
To: Samir Gupta <samir@harborai.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>, Alicia Park <procurement@harborai.com>
Date: Thu, 02 May 2028 11:06:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Packaging for dashboards + trace retention (Harbor AI)

Samir — really appreciate the clear list. Quick answers up top, followed by an attached worked example.

TL;DR:
- Trace retention: we recommend a hybrid model — 30 days of hot retention (index + fast queries) + archiving tier for 90–365 days based on search SLA. At ~1B tokens/month your break-even typically arises when archival is >4TB/month; at that point per-GB archival plus retrieval fees becomes cheaper than extending hot retention.
- Advanced dashboards: sold as an add-on SKU ("Advanced Visuals") that can be bundled for discounts when purchased with a retention commit. Feature gating is by entitlement, not seats.
- Pilot/commit discounts: standard pilot: $15k pilot credit + 60-day trial; 12-month commit discounts scale: 10% @ $X, 18% @ $Y, 25% @ enterprise carveout. We can provide a stronger concession for strategic pilots.

I've attached a sample workbook (tabbed: pilot-path, 12mo-commit, steady-state) that runs the numbers against Harbor's usage snapshot. Key concession options we can offer: 
- One-time onboarding credit (covers one month of Advanced Visuals)
- Prorated pilot credits applied to first-month invoices if you convert to a committed ARR within 90 days
- Waived API overage for first 2 months of the pilot (select endpoints)

Next steps I propose: Ben will review the commercial levers and produce a two-option term sheet (Conservative vs Accelerated savings) with exact list prices and net pricing. Laura can provide the SOW onboarding credit language if preferred. If procurement wants a single-tab price summary for review, I can send that today.

Attachment: pricing_workbook_v3.xlsx (spreadsheet)

Cheers,
Mina Haddad
Senior Account Executive, Redwood Inference
mina_haddad@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0198

From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
To: Samir Gupta <samir@harborai.com>, Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.ai>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>, Alicia Park <procurement@harborai.com>
Date: Fri, 03 May 2028 08:17:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Packaging for dashboards + trace retention (Harbor AI)

Samir / Alicia — following up with two concrete commercial approaches (summary here; detailed tabs in the workbook Mina sent):

1) Conservative (low upfront):
- Pilot: $15k credits + waived onboarding for pilot (60d)
- 12mo commit: 10% discount on Advanced Visuals + retention at committed rates (min $Z/month)
- Archival: standard per-GB at $0.XX/GB with retrieval tiered by SLA

2) Accelerated (preferred for faster ROI):
- Pilot: $25k credits applied to first invoice if converted within 60d
- 12mo commit: 18% discount on Advanced Visuals; retention tiers bumped down one slab (effectively ~12–15% cost reduction on retention at your volume)
- One-time onboarding credit equal to one month of Advanced Visuals (applied to SOW)

Alicia — for procurement, we can convert the Accelerated option into a single one-page commercial summary and a DocuSign envelope if Harbor is comfortable with the commit thresholds. If Harbor needs a formal SOW we will route through Laura for legal language.

If you're open, Mina and I can host a 30-min call with procurement early next week to walk through the workbook and finalize the preferred option.

—Ben
Ben Carter
Director, Commercial Ops, Redwood Inference

From: Alicia Park <procurement@harborai.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.ai>
Cc: Samir Gupta <samir@harborai.com>, Harbor AI Billing <billing@harborai.com>
Date: Sat, 04 May 2028 16:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Packaging for dashboards + trace retention (Harbor AI)

Ben / Mina — thank you. Harbor prefers the Accelerated option but needs two clarifications before routing to legal/billing: 

1) Can you confirm the effective monthly spend floor that triggers the 18% discount (we need the exact $ commitment line item)?
2) Please confirm the retention SLAs for the "bumped down one slab" — specifically max query latency (p95) for archived lookups vs hot retention. Our compliance team will also want the data residency statement for archived data (we're US-only).

If these are acceptable we will proceed to sign. Please send the one-page commercial summary and a DocuSign link for the Accelerated option.

Attachment: harbor_po_template.docx (procurement template)

—Alicia Park
Senior Procurement Manager, Harbor AI
